'''Cristiane Justino Venâncio'''<ref>{{Cite web |title=Cris Cyborg {{!}} MMA Fighter Page |url=https://www.tapology.com/fightcenter/fighters/cristiane-santos-cyborg |access-date=2024-09-21 |website=Tapology |language=en}}</ref> (born July 9, 1985), known professionally as '''Cris Cyborg''' and formerly by her married name '''Cristiane Santos''', is a Brazilian and American professional [[mixed martial artist]] and [[Professional boxing|professional boxer]] who currently competes in the Women’s [[Featherweight (MMA)|Featherweight]] division of the [[Professional Fighters League]] (PFL), where she is the current and inaugural [[List of Professional Fighters League champions#Women's Featherweight World Championship|PFL Women's Featherweight World Champion]]. As a boxer, she is  the current [[Women's International Boxing Association#Current champions|WIBA Light Middleweight World Champion]].
